context: Hina asks Sho about PC functions.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、このパソコン、機能、たくさん？
lines.en: Sho — does this computer have lots of different things it can do?
lines.style: Bright, eager eight-year-old. Quick opening, warm curiosity lifting at the end. Real childish enthusiasm without performing it. Soft throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah — it has lots of them.
lines.style: Quiet six-year-old confidence. Small, genuine warmth. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Soft steady delivery, the patience of knowing something.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Will you show me? Does it have drawing?
lines.style: Hopeful reach in the voice. Eight-year-old wanting to share something with him. Building excitement at the question. Not demanding — inviting. Warm and engaged.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small decisive warmth. Six-year-old moving into action. Soft but committed. The gentle confidence of doing something for someone he likes.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure delight breaking open. Eight-year-old brightness at its fullest. The word 'together' carries real weight to her. Warm and genuine throughout, no performance.
